title: Insider threat in practice
intro: Mistake or intent: use the right channel. Decide what you would do in each moment from this module's lessons.

decisions.title: List for the report
decisions.prompt: What do you do with this e-mail?

artifact.subject: List for the report
body: Hi, I will work from home tonight.
Please send the staff list (ID numbers, phones) to my personal mail: nigar.84@poctam.example

options.label: Send the list to her personal mail
Reply: I cannot send it to personal mail

decisions.explain: Working from home goes through approved tools, such as work mail over the VPN.

decisions.title: Message from Tural Həsənov
decisions.prompt: What do you do with this message?

artifact.name: Tural Həsənov
body: Hi, they closed my access by mistake.
Give me your password, I will take the project folders from the archive and return it tomorrow.

options.label: I cannot give my password, contact IT support

decisions.explain: If access was closed, only IT and the manager can sort it out.

decisions.title: FaylDaşı: free file transfer
decisions.prompt: The file was too big for email, so you found a free site. What do you do?

artifact.title: FaylDaşı: free file transfer
body: Anyone with the link can download the file.

options.label: Copy the link and send it to the partner
Cancel and ask IT for the approved way

decisions.explain: IT support will show you the approved way to send a large file safely.

decisions.title: Estimate shared

artifact.subject: Estimate shared
body: I shared the file on the internal portal with our department only.

decisions.explain: An approved internal place and limited access. This is the right way to share.

decisions.title: Kontakto: Your post is live

artifact.title: Kontakto: Your post is live
body: "My first day!" The photo shows your badge and an internal system on screen.

decisions.explain: A badge and a work screen give attackers what they need to fake a card and pick targets.
